_readme: Trades executed via LM tools (so ESPN has no TRADE_ACCEPT record) and
pick swaps tracked in the commissioner's notes. Merged into activity.json.
Each trade: {season, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', week (scoring period it lands in),
{player: 'Player Name', from: teamA_id, to: teamB_id}   -- players by name
{pick: '2027 2nd', from: teamB_id, to: teamA_id}        -- picks as text
Player names are matched against the NFL player list; unmatched names fail
the build loudly rather than guessing.
pick_ownership: current holder of every traded future pick, one entry per
pick: {season, round, original_team_id, owned_by_team_id, via: 'free text'}.
